This is your chance. No more excuses. You’ll finally make your dream come true. You’re determined to find love, and what better place to start than your college campus?

With a lucky four-leaf clover in hand, fate is on your side. Will you finally build up the courage to confess to your crush? Or will an unexpected spark reignite the affection between you and your childhood friend?
